source: The central lesson is that a ZXNAME0000XZ is a throughput machine, not a single giant arithmetic unit. A high peak FLOP rate, high occupancy, or a dashboard showing “100% ZXNAME0001XZ utilization” does not by itself establish that an AI workload is running efficiently. Those quantities measure different things.[2,4]
zh: 核心教训是 ZXNAME0000XZ 是一台吞吐量机器，而不是一个巨大的算术单元。高峰值 FLOP 率、高占用率或显示“100% ZXNAME0001XZ 利用率”的仪表板本身并不能证明 AI 工作负载正在高效运行。这些量衡量的是不同的事物。[2,4]
